name: fairquery-company-jobs-feed-mcp
description: Local MCP server: live jobs from companies' public Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards. Free local tools; optional paid multi-company search uses your own Apify token.
long_description: Runs on your machine over stdio. Free tools need no account or token and call the official public job-board APIs of Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby directly from your machine (board name and job IDs are sent to those ATS APIs): fetch and filter one board, find a company's board, re-check whether a job is still open, and list a bundled starter set of verified boards. The optional paid tool jobs_search_companies runs the public Apify Actor fairquery/company-jobs-feed with YOUR OWN Apify API token and is billed to your Apify account; leave the token empty to use only the free tools. Fairquery code sends nothing to Fairquery. Tip: use an Apify scoped token limited to running fairquery/company-jobs-feed.

tools.name: jobs_get_board
tools.description: Free. Fetch every job on one company board from its official public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby API, normalized and filtered locally.

tools.name: jobs_find_board
tools.description: Free. Resolve a company name, domain or careers/board URL to its public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board(s).

tools.name: jobs_check_open
tools.description: Free. Re-check one job on the employer's ATS right now and report open or closed.

tools.name: jobs_list_seed_boards
tools.description: Free (offline). List the bundled starter set of company boards verified on their official ATS APIs.

tools.name: jobs_search_companies
tools.description: Paid (your Apify token). Run fairquery/company-jobs-feed over many companies: discovery, filters, history and repost signals.

apify_token.title: Apify API token (optional)
apify_token.description: Optional. YOUR OWN Apify API token, only needed for the paid jobs_search_companies tool; usage is billed to your Apify account. Leave empty to use only the free tools. Create one at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations (a scoped token limited to fairquery/company-jobs-feed is recommended).
